version.changelog:
Version 1.0.42 of ab-test-analyzer

- No user-facing changes detected in this release.
- All documentation and features remain unchanged.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (A/B test analysis) matches its runtime instructions and it requests no credentials or installs, but it is instruction-only with no implementation or source link so its actual functionality is uncertain.

dimensions.detail: The name, description, and SKILL.md all describe A/B test analysis and the example commands reference importing data, analyzing, and reporting — these are coherent. However, there is no implementation or install spec included (instruction-only), and skill.json version (1.0.0) differs from the registry version (1.0.42), which could indicate packaging drift or missing source.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs importing a user-provided CSV, running analysis, and producing reports. It does not ask the agent to read unrelated files, access environment variables, or contact external endpoints outside the described task.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files. This minimizes installation risk, but also means the skill may be purely documentation/instruction rather than an executable integration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Nothing requested appears disproportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags show the skill is not forced-always and uses default autonomous invocation settings. It does not request persistent system-level presence or modify other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and low-risk because it asks for no credentials or installs. Two caveats: (1) it is instruction-only with no code or source/homepage, so it may be a stub or purely documentation rather than a working plugin — ask the publisher or check the platform mapping to confirm it actually performs analysis; (2) verify how your data (CSV) will be processed by the platform before uploading any sensitive information. If you need guaranteed behavior, request source code or an official release link and test on non-sensitive sample data first.
